title: Your first in-app update
thisBuild: If you are reading this, the Update bar worked. Tell me with a quick note: did Android ask you anything, and did the notice bring you back in?
The red quick-note bar now sits above the bottom bar, so Menu, Hold and Chords stay in reach while you talk.
From build 94: tap the bug, talk, tap it again, and the note waits on the phone. Notes for Claude and Send all are in the ☰ menu.
watch: A long quick note with pauses: does it keep everything you said?
The proposal for notes 20 to 22 is waiting for your answers before the next real build.
limits: Nothing new to play in this build: it exists so you can try the Update bar.
The app cannot reopen itself after an update; the notice is one tap. Without notification permission, open it from the home screen.
